Subject: Re: perldoc using fancy quotes

On 19 Nov 2007 22:07:23 +0100, Slaven Rezic  wrote:
> May I ask the question if perldoc should still use nroff as the
> default translator or if we should switch to just pod2text (the same
> as perldoc -t does it already)? Sure, the pod2text output is not as
> nice as the pod2man output (no bold text, no underline, no
> hyphenation), but one is not dependent on the nroff oddities and the
> nearly complete lack of Unicode support (other than latin1).

Having been annoyed by nroff too in the past, I would think that's a
good evolution for perldoc.
